segments.he: הִקְדִּישָׁהּ שְׁתַּיִם וְשָׁלֹשׁ וְכוּ׳. תָּנוּ רַבָּנַן:
segments.en: § The mishna teaches that if «he consecrated» the field «two or three years» before the Jubilee Year and wishes to redeem it, he gives the Temple treasury a sela and a pundeyon per year. In this regard, «the Sages taught» a baraita that deals with the verse: “But if he sanctifies his field after the Jubilee, then the priest shall reckon for him the money according to the years that remain until the Jubilee Year, and a deduction shall be made from your valuation” (Leviticus 27:18).
